completionSentence: 사용자는 자신의 T5 자료가 어디에 있고 무엇이 기록되며 어떤 정보가 어느 모델·외부 서비스로 나갔는지 이해하고, T5 전체를 멈추고 백업하고 옮기고 지울 수 있다.
qualified: One local ownership surface shows UI-independent runtime truth, local conversation-memory-work-automation counts, current model and continuity policy, recent transmission categories, connections, activity recording, backup and deletion scope.
The surface contains no canonical ids, local absolute paths, wire digests, credential values or provider raw transcript.
Unknown provider retention and training behavior remains explicitly unknown rather than inferred from local execution.
Encrypted whole-state backup and isolated restore remain the existing product actions on the same settings page.
Local full delete requires two user confirmations and an exact server acknowledgement that external-service copies and separate backup files remain.
Deletion drains the resident runtime, releases ownership and removes only the configured local T5 state root.
notClaimed: Deletion of provider or external-service copies
Deletion of backup files stored separately by the user
Knowledge of provider-side retention, training or deletion policy
Physical installed-product delete qualification on macOS or Windows
